# MKR Safety Solutions

> MKR Safety Solutions installs invisible grill safety systems in Bangalore, India, using ultra-fine 316-grade marine stainless steel cables for balconies, windows, staircases, terraces, villas, and child-safety applications.

MKR Safety Solutions specializes in nearly-invisible safety grilles that preserve views while preventing falls. Services include balcony invisible grills, window invisible grills, staircase invisible grills, terrace invisible grills, villa invisible grills, and child safety grills. All installations use 3mm ultra-fine 316-grade stainless steel cables, load-tested to 250 kg/m, with a 10-year warranty.

## Services

- [Balcony Invisible Grills](https://mkrsafetysolutions.com/balcony-invisible-grills): Secure open balconies with nearly-invisible cable grilles.
- [Window Invisible Grills](https://mkrsafetysolutions.com/window-invisible-grills): Replace heavy iron grills with unobtrusive cable safety systems.
- [Staircase Invisible Grills](https://mkrsafetysolutions.com/staircase-invisible-grills): Fall protection for open staircases.
- [Terrace Invisible Grills](https://mkrsafetysolutions.com/terrace-invisible-grills): Safety grilles for terrace and rooftop spaces.
- [Villa Invisible Grills](https://mkrsafetysolutions.com/villa-invisible-grills): Whole-property invisible grill installations for villas.
- [Child Safety Grills](https://mkrsafetysolutions.com/child-invisible-grills): Child-safe grille systems for homes with young children.
